supplements.title: Parthenolide inhibits the progression of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma by promoting ferroptosis through inhibiting UBD.
supplements.summary: Parthenolide, a natural compound, slows intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma growth by triggering cancer cell death through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Resveratrol inhibits aerobic glycolysis and promotes cuproptosis in acute myeloid leukemia via the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking a growth pathway and triggering copper-dependent cell death.

supplements.title: Targeting p38α, p38γ, and ERα with bioactive compounds from royal jelly for anti-breast cancer activity: A comprehensive in-silico study using fingerprint analysis, molecular dynamics, MEP, and PCA.
supplements.summary: Royal jelly compounds chrysin, galangin, and naringin show promise against breast cancer by binding strongly to key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin enhances the antitumor effect of Taxol on human breast cancer MCF-7 cells via ferroptosis mediated by the MDM2-p53-YAP1 axis.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin combined with Taxol enhances breast cancer cell death by triggering a natural cell death process called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Vitamin D receptor isoform VDRA suppresses hepatocellular tumorigenesis by restricting YAP nuclear localization.
supplements.summary: A vitamin D receptor variant called VDRA suppresses liver cancer by blocking the cancer-promoting protein YAP from entering cell nuclei.

supplements.title: Nanoliposomal Eucommia ulmoides extract limits PANoptosis in sepsis-induced acute lung injury through a TGF-β1-JNK pathway.
supplements.summary: A nanoparticle form of plant extract reduced harmful immune cell death in sepsis-related lung injury through a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Prevent 6:1 trial: pI rotocol for a feasibility trial of a 6:1 intermittent diet for weight gain prevention in women at increased risk of breast cancer.
supplements.summary: A weekly fasting day diet is being tested to prevent weight gain in women at high risk of breast cancer.

supplements.title: A Curcumin-Derived HSP70 Inhibitor Disrupts Lysosomal Function to Suppress Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Progression.
supplements.summary: A curcumin-derived compound targets HSP70 protein to disrupt lysosomes, effectively suppressing triple-negative breast cancer growth and metastasis.

supplements.title: Secondary metabolites from the mangrove endophytic fungus Curvularia sp. P3.
supplements.summary: Compound 13 from mangrove fungus showed promising activity against lung cancer cells and inhibited bacterial growth.

supplements.title: Exercise as supportive care in advanced cancer-related weight loss: a feasibility study comparing patients with and without severe weight loss.
supplements.summary: Exercise may help advanced cancer patients manage severe weight loss, though benefits vary based on cachexia severity.

supplements.title: Resveratrol-mediated disruption of the CD73-adenosine-A2AR/A2BR axis induces antitumor activity in colon cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol kills colon cancer cells by blocking the adenosine pathway that normally suppresses immune responses against tumors.

supplements.title: Diet-induced phospholipid remodeling dictates ferroptosis sensitivity and tumorigenesis in the pancreas.
supplements.summary: High-fat diets rich in certain unsaturated fats increase pancreatic cancer risk by reducing cancer cells' sensitivity to ferroptosis, a natural death process.

supplements.title: Soft Magnetism Meets Self-Assembly: Molecularly Engineered Magnetic Ionic Liquid Nanomicelles for the Solubilization, Sustained Release, and Anticancer Activity of Quercetin.
supplements.summary: Magnetic nanoparticles improved quercetin delivery and doubled its cancer-killing power against colon cancer cells.

supplements.title: Gut Mycobiota-Associated Tryptophan Catabolites Protect Against Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease.
supplements.summary: Gut fungus Saccharomyces cerevisiae produces a compound that reduces liver fat accumulation and metabolic dysfunction in mice and patients.

supplements.title: Exploring Biologically-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine Use Among Irish Cancer Survivors: Findings from a National Survey.
supplements.summary: Irish cancer survivors commonly use unregulated dietary supplements and herbal remedies without medical supervision, risking harmful interactions with prescribed treatments.

off_label.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.
off_label.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

off_label.title: Alisertib exerts AURKA-independent antitumor activity in colon cancer by modulating immune-related pathways.
off_label.summary: Alisertib fights colon cancer through immune-pathway activation independent of its primary AURKA target.

off_label.title: Investigation of the nitric oxide signaling pathway induced by ezetimibe on renal injury in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rat: role of anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory effects.
off_label.summary: Ezetimibe, a cholesterol drug, reduced kidney damage in diabetic rats by increasing nitric oxide and reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: Preparation of CPD12C15 hyaluronic acid nanoparticles, a novel glycolytic inhibitor and preliminary pharmacologic study on anti-pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: Novel nanoparticles delivering CPD12C15 with copper inhibit pancreatic cancer growth by blocking the metabolic pathway that drives drug resistance.

off_label.title: Multi-ancestry genome-wide association and integrated multi-omics analyses of endometriosis and its clinical manifestations.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified 80 genetic regions linked to endometriosis risk, revealing immune dysfunction and inflammation as key disease mechanisms, suggesting new treatment possibilities.

off_label.title: Inhibition of angiogenesis by propranolol in infantile hemangiomas via lncRNA NEAT1-mediated miR-194-5p/TRAF6/NF-κB pathway.
off_label.summary: Propranolol treats infantile hemangiomas by blocking blood vessel growth through a specific genetic pathway involving NEAT1.

off_label.title: Integrative systems biology and drug repurposing reveal key regulatory hubs and a prognostic signature in gastric cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified key regulatory genes and prognostic markers in gastric cancer using drug repurposing to improve treatment options.

off_label.title: Effect of cationic amphiphilic drugs on mRNA lipoplex-induced protein expression.
off_label.summary: Certain common drugs enhance mRNA vaccine delivery to lung tissue but may reduce immune response, warranting caution in patient treatment.

off_label.title: USP15 stabilizes c-Myc to drive sunitinib resistance by suppressing cuproptosis in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: USP15 protein drives sunitinib resistance in kidney cancer by blocking copper-induced cell death; blocking USP15 restores drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: Rosuvastatin Ameliorates the Initiation and Progression of Lung Adenocarcinoma via Facilitating PLK1 Inhibition.
off_label.summary: Rosuvastatin, a cholesterol drug, slows lung adenocarcinoma growth by blocking a protein called PLK1.

off_label.title: The role of oxidative stress and antioxidant therapy in cisplatin neurotoxicity: preclinical evidence in the last decade.
off_label.summary: Antioxidant therapy shows promise in protecting nerve cells from damage caused by cisplatin cancer treatment in animal studies.

off_label.title: Evaluation of Dronabinol to Decrease Opioid Use for Cancer-Induced Bone Pain.
off_label.summary: Dronabinol, a cannabis-based medication, may reduce opioid needs in breast cancer patients with bone metastases.

off_label.title: BACH2 controls ILC3 function via PPARγ-dependent mitochondrial metabolism.
off_label.summary: BACH2 protein protects intestinal immunity by activating PPARγ, restoring immune cell function and reducing colitis severity in mice.

off_label.title: Metformin in prostate cancer: a context-dependent antitumour strategy driven by metabolic vulnerability and signalling network.
off_label.summary: Metformin may help prevent prostate cancer by disrupting cancer cell energy production and signaling, but benefits vary by disease stage and patient type.

off_label.title: Repurposing metformin for choriocarcinoma: targeting the AMPK/mTOR pathway.
off_label.summary: Metformin, a diabetes drug, reduces choriocarcinoma growth by targeting cancer cell pathways, offering a new treatment option.

biomarkers.summary: CYP1B1 protein drives harmful immune cells that cause colitis and colorectal cancer by controlling cellular energy and oxidative stress.

biomarkers.title: UBE2C-orchestrated ubiquitination networks in cancer progression and therapy resistance.
biomarkers.summary: UBE2C protein drives cancer progression and drug resistance by rewiring cellular protein networks across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Preparation and MR Imaging Study of a Recombinant Surface Antibody Superparamagnetic Iron Oxide Nanoparticle-EPC1 Molecular Probe for Hepatic Alveolar Echinococcosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a magnetic nanoparticle probe to improve MRI detection of a parasitic liver infection called hepatic alveolar echinococcosis.

biomarkers.title: Crosstalk between integrin signaling and NAD⁺ biosynthetic pathways promotes glycolysis, proliferation, survival, and tumor growth in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking integrin and NAD⁺ production pathways together dramatically suppresses triple-negative breast cancer tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: Safety and efficacy of intratumoural anti-CTLA4 with intravenous anti-PD1.
biomarkers.summary: Injecting anti-CTLA4 directly into melanoma tumors combined with intravenous anti-PD1 improves safety while maintaining effectiveness.

biomarkers.summary: Eating before T cell collection enhances immune cell function and improves therapeutic effectiveness in cancer immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Evolutionary characterization of lung cancer metastasis.
biomarkers.summary: Lung cancer metastases evolve significantly after spreading, with multiple tumors seeding each other and chromosomal instability enabling distant spread.

biomarkers.title: Regional HNSCC metabolomics reveals widespread changes to one-carbon metabolism and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism across tumour core, tumour edge and adjacent non-tumour tissues.
biomarkers.summary: Head and neck cancer alters one-carbon and methionine metabolism differently across tumor regions and surrounding tissue.

biomarkers.title: Tumour-induced osteomalacia: a diagnostic conundrum.
biomarkers.summary: Rare bone tumors causing phosphate loss can be missed for years; surgery and vitamin supplementation led to complete patient recovery.

trials.title: Prescribing practices for menopausal hormone therapy in France in 2025: A national online survey (MENOPRAT).
trials.summary: French gynecologists' hormone therapy prescribing practices for menopause vary, with some using alternatives due to perceived barriers.

trials.title: A Qualitative Study of the Implementation of Referral Coordination for Specialty Care Referrals in the Veterans Health Administration.
trials.summary: The VA implemented a referral coordination system where clinicians review and discuss specialty care options with veterans before scheduling appointments.

trials.title: Perspectives and Requirements of Patients with Prostate Cancer on Mobile Health Interventions During Androgen Deprivation Therapy: A Descriptive Qualitative Study.
trials.summary: Prostate cancer patients undergoing hormone therapy want mobile health tools to manage their treatment side effects and improve daily care.

trials.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

trials.title: Efficacy and safety of acupuncture for breast cancer-related insomnia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Acupuncture may improve sleep quality in breast cancer patients with insomnia, though evidence strength remains low due to methodological limitations.

trials.title: Prospective evaluation of acute side effects profiles in moderately hypofractionated whole-pelvic radiotherapy for prostate cancer.
trials.summary: Study compares patient-reported and doctor-reported side effects from two prostate cancer radiation treatment approaches.

trials.title: Design and Synthesis of USP1 Inhibitors: Synergistic Antitumor Activity with PARP Inhibitors in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new drug that blocks USP1 protein, which works synergistically with existing PARP inhibitors to fight triple-negative breast cancer more effectively.

trials.title: TCRVβ-targeting antibody-drug conjugates as a novel strategy to eliminate malignant T cells in T cell cancers.
trials.summary: Researchers developed antibody-drug conjugates targeting specific T cell receptor variants to selectively kill cutaneous T cell lymphoma cancer cells while sparing healthy immune cells.

trials.title: Adeno-associated virus gene therapy-mediated CCR5 blockade suppresses virus replication long term in SHIV-infected macaques.
trials.summary: Gene therapy delivering an HIV-blocking antibody long-term controlled virus in most treated monkeys, showing promise for functional HIV cure.

trials.title: High Nasopharyngeal SARS-CoV-2 Load and Delayed Clearance in Hospitalized Patients With Blood Autoantibodies Neutralizing Type I Interferons.
trials.summary: Patients with blood antibodies blocking interferon had higher virus levels and slower viral clearance during COVID-19 hospitalization.

trials.title: Population Pharmacokinetics of Melphalan in Pediatric Patients Undergoing Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation with Various Conditioning Regimens.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a dosing model for melphalan, a chemotherapy drug used in stem cell transplants for pediatric cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.
mind_body.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

mind_body.title: Efficacy and safety of acupuncture for breast cancer-related insomnia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may improve sleep quality in breast cancer patients with insomnia, though evidence strength remains low due to methodological limitations.

mind_body.title: Decreasing Chemotherapy Induced Distress Using Immersive Virtual Reality in Patients With Cancer
mind_body.summary: Virtual reality during chemotherapy significantly reduces patient distress, anxiety, depression, and pain compared to standard care.

mind_body.title: Spiritual Well-Being and Hope in Oncology Patients.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients show high spiritual well-being and hope levels, with hope significantly strengthening spiritual well-being.

mind_body.title: Yoga for Patients Undergoing Thoracic Radiotherapy and Their Family Caregivers: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Yoga involving thoracic cancer patients and their family caregivers improved quality of life better than education alone during radiotherapy treatment.

mind_body.title: Attitudes, Practices, and Barriers to Spiritual Care for Patients With Cancer: An International Survey.
mind_body.summary: Oncology clinicians recognize spiritual care as important but face significant barriers to providing it to cancer patients in practice.

mind_body.title: Analysis of the circRNA/lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA Networks of Action of Fire Needle Acupuncture in Relieving Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathic Pain.
mind_body.summary: Fire needle acupuncture may relieve chemotherapy-induced nerve pain through specific molecular pathways, offering a potential treatment alternative.

mind_body.title: Social prescribing for people recovering from treatment for cancer: a systematic scoping review.
mind_body.summary: Social prescribing—connecting cancer survivors with community activities—helps address emotional and social challenges during recovery.

mind_body.title: Exploring psychosocial outcomes of fly-fishing retreats for cancer survivors: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Fly-fishing retreats help cancer survivors improve their wellbeing through nature-based activities and social connection.

mind_body.title: A mixed-methods longitudinal study of demoralization and depression in breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: Breast cancer survivors commonly experience demoralization and depression after treatment, conditions that warrant separate clinical attention and further study.

mind_body.title: [The effect of physiotherapy treatments on the immune system].
mind_body.summary: Exercise and physiotherapy strengthen immune defenses against tumors by boosting natural killer cells and reducing inflammation.

mind_body.title: Treatment of neuropathic pain in cancer survivors: a scoping review of pharmacological, exercise, and psychosocial interventions.
mind_body.summary: Cancer survivors can manage neuropathic pain through medications, exercise, and psychological treatments, according to a comprehensive research review.

mind_body.title: [Moxibustion enhances the antitumor efficacy of Trametinib in breast cancer-bearing mice via MEK/ERK signaling pathway].
mind_body.summary: Moxibustion combined with Trametinib drug treatment more effectively slows breast cancer growth in mice than either treatment alone.

mind_body.title: [Effect of electroacupuncture on microglial polarization and activity of α7nAChR-TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway in the anterior cingulate cortex of rats with chronic inflammatory pain-depression comorbidity].
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture reduces pain and depression in rats by changing how brain immune cells respond through a specific cellular pathway.

mind_body.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a stress-management behavioral weight loss intervention for Black breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: A stress management weight loss program for Black breast cancer survivors proved feasible, acceptable, and achieved significant weight loss and stress reduction.
